verdict.rationale: New Relic's evidence covers alerting (thresholds, notification routing) and SLIs/SLOs, but there is no documentation of incident timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies — these are typically features of dedicated incident-management tools (e.g., PagerDuty/Opsgenie) that New Relic integrates with rather than natively provides. Missing for 10: on-call scheduling, escalation policy configuration, and incident timeline/postmortem tracking.
